messages:
Carmen: Hey team — quick experiment ask. I updated the pricing page draft with 2 small micro-FAQ blocks under the calculator and 3 alternative tier names. Want to smoke-test clarity before we push to staging. Link: https://drive.redwood/pricing/microfaq-v2 (permission: marketing-view)

Jordan: Looking now. TL;DR: the calculator copy is good but the FAQ needs one sentence that reassures on committed vs metered billing. Suggest: \"Committed credits apply first; metered usage is billed monthly for overage.\"

Mira: +1 on that line. Also think we should A/B test tier names — current options: Prospect/Team/Enterprise vs Core/Scale/Enterprise vs Starter/Pro/Enterprise. My vote is Core/Pro/Enterprise (clean for engineering buyers).

Noah: For the A/B we'll need events. Proposed event names: \`pricing_calc_opened\`, \`pricing_calc_selected_tier\`, \`pricing_faq_expanded\`. Can we standardize to snake_case? that'll keep analytics dashboards simple.

Carmen: Good call. Jordan — can you draft the microcopy variants? Mira — can you set up experiment in Optimizely with 50/25/25 split for copy/tier/name? Noah — will you add the events? I can shepherd the staging push.

Jordan: Drafted three microcopy options in the doc: (1) explicit billing reassurance, (2) short performance note about latency tiers, (3) pointer to runtime SLA for Dedicated customers. I left markers next to each FAQ so Mira can map to the experiment keys.

Mira: Setting up the experiment now. Quick question: do we want the calculator to show committed discounts inline or only after you enter usage? My recommendation: show baseline price by default and a subtle \"Committed discount available\" pill that expands. Less surprising for users.

Noah: I can track both flows — `discount_pill_seen` and `discount_details_expanded`. Also will add a gating flag so we only record for visitors in the experiment bucket. Pushed a short snippet for client instrumentation in the doc:```
window.rwTrack('pricing_calc_opened', { variant: 'B' })
```

SamBot: deploy scheduled: staging/pricing-page v2026.3.21-rc5 queued by Carmen — ETA 10m. :rocket:

Carmen: Perfect. After we run ~2k calc interactions or 7 days (whichever first) let's regroup and decide final tier labels. Also cc @support for any inbound script tweaks if customers ask about \"Core\" naming.

Jordan: I'll draft a short help-blurb for support and a click-to-copy FAQ snippet.

Mira: Experiment set, tracking wired, staging push looks green. Will start routing 30% of marketing traffic and 10% organic to variants today.

Noah: Event schema added to the analytics repo, feel free to QA. I'll post the view when data streams in.

Carmen: Thanks all — very lightweight run. If we see big drops in calc completion we abort fast. Otherwise we'll iterate on micro-FAQ language and finalize tier names for launch notes and webinar talking points. :thumbsup:
